data.name: Kitty Party, But Make It Cardio
data.headline: Kitty party, but make it cardio.
data.benefit: Kitty party, but make it cardio. Book out the studio for your crew — up to 12 people, your playlist, our instructor. Everyone new gets 3 classes for the price of 2 afterwards.
data.rationale: Hosted classes are a top lead source (Kwality 394, Bandra 353, Kenkere 281 leads) but convert only 4.6–6.1%. A paid bookout has a host who brings warm friends and pays for the room.
data.audience: Anyone booking the studio for a private group of up to 12.

data.name: The Second Date's On Us
data.headline: First date: half price. Second date: on us. Third: it's a relationship.
data.benefit: First date: half price. Second date: on us. Third date? That's a relationship — 15% off your first month and an extra freeze for when life gets busy.
data.rationale: Kenkere logged 3,217 leads in 12 months; only 36% reached a trial and 13.1% converted. 581 single-class sales show high drop-in, low commitment. A booked second visit lifts conversion from 10.8% to 43.9%.
data.conditions: Standard 15% only; freeze has no cash value.

data.name: Gone With the Wind, Back With the Rain
data.headline: Left us in the summer heat? Come back for the monsoon.
data.benefit: Left us in the summer heat? Come back for the monsoon: 15% off, 2 extra freezes for flooded days, and a lane in The Amazing Race 2.0.
data.rationale: An event with a start date beats a generic reminder. Freezes answer the monsoon objection at no cash cost.

data.name: Rain Check (Literally)
data.headline: Monsoon happens. Your late-cancel fee doesn't have to.
data.benefit: Monsoon happens. Your late-cancel fee doesn't have to. Renew in July: 10% off, 3 'Rain Check' tokens, and classes credited back on red-alert days.
data.rationale: Average late cancels per membership: Bandra 1.18, Kenkere 1.36. Late-cancel fees in the monsoon make members feel they 'wasted' a month and lapse.
